notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
When the Knight dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
